description: SolaX hybrid and energy storage inverters over Modbus RTU: PV, grid, EPS and battery real-time values, meter values, energy counters, BMS data, status, and inverter, battery and work mode settings
source: SolaX Power, Energy Storage Inverter MODBUS Communication protocols, version V001.02

sources.title: SolaX Power Energy Storage Inverter MODBUS Communication protocols
sources.note: chapter 3, register tables; copy uploaded to the Symcon community forum

notes: Modbus RTU on RS485 (the inverter itself has no Modbus TCP; use a gateway). Default address 1. Wait at least 1 s between requests.

Read data use function 04 (input registers); configuration is read with function 03 and written with 06 or 16. Writable settings have a write address and a separate read-back address; both are listed, the write one marked '(write)'.
Registers are big endian. The protocol does not state the word order of 32-bit values; this map assumes the low word first, the usual order on SolaX inverters. Check one value on the device.
Not every register exists on every model; the protocol marks some values as X1 or X3 only.
The VPP (remote power control) mode tables are not in this map: their registers change meaning with the VPP mode. Some other tables of the protocol that could not be read reliably are also left out.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
